tools.name: weel_list_users
tools.description: List the active employees of the business. Weel API: GET /v1/businesses/{client_id}/users.

tools.name: weel_get_user
tools.description: Get one employee by id, with role and delegation settings. Weel API: GET /v1/businesses/{client_id}/users/{user_id}.

tools.name: weel_list_user_budget_members
tools.description: List the budgets a user is a member of. Weel API: GET /v1/businesses/{client_id}/users/{user_id}/budget-members.

tools.name: weel_list_invites
tools.description: List pending and accepted user invites (cancelled ones are excluded). Weel API: GET /v1/businesses/{client_id}/invites.

tools.name: weel_list_roles
tools.description: List the roles that can be assigned to users in the business. Weel API: GET /v1/businesses/{client_id}/roles.

tools.name: weel_list_transactions
tools.description: List card and reimbursement transactions, newest first, with optional date, status and expense-completion filters. Purchases have negative amounts. Weel API: GET /v3/businesses/{client_id}/transactions.

tools.name: weel_get_transaction
tools.description: Get one transaction by id, including GST (same sign as amount). Weel API: GET /v3/businesses/{client_id}/transactions/{transaction_id}.

tools.name: weel_list_budgets
tools.description: List budgets and subscriptions, with optional type and member-limit filters. Weel API: GET /v1/businesses/{client_id}/budgets.

tools.name: weel_get_budget
tools.description: Get one budget's settings and available amount. Weel API: GET /v1/businesses/{client_id}/budgets/{budget_id}.

tools.name: weel_list_budget_members
tools.description: List the users invited to a budget. Weel API: GET /v1/businesses/{client_id}/budgets/{budget_id}/members.

tools.name: weel_get_budget_member
tools.description: Get one budget member, including its reset amount when the budget has member limits. Weel API: GET /v1/businesses/{client_id}/budgets/{budget_id}/members/{budget_member_id}.

tools.name: weel_list_budget_owners
tools.description: List the owners of a budget. Weel API: GET /v1/businesses/{client_id}/budgets/{budget_id}/owners.

tools.name: weel_list_budget_topups
tools.description: List the top-ups (available-amount changes) of a budget. Weel API: GET /v1/businesses/{client_id}/budgets/{budget_id}/topups.

tools.name: weel_list_budget_member_topups
tools.description: List the top-ups of one budget member. Weel API: GET /v1/businesses/{client_id}/budgets/{budget_id}/members/{budget_member_id}/topups.

tools.name: weel_list_statements
tools.description: List account balance statements for a date range. Weel API: GET /v1/businesses/{client_id}/statements.

tools.name: weel_get_balances
tools.description: Get the real-time balance for each currency of the business. Weel API: GET /v1/businesses/{client_id}/balance.

tools.name: weel_list_custom_fields
tools.description: List the custom fields of the business (tags for expenses). Weel API: GET /v1/businesses/{client_id}/custom-fields.

tools.name: weel_get_custom_field
tools.description: Get one custom field by id. Weel API: GET /v1/businesses/{client_id}/custom-fields/{custom_field_id}.

tools.name: weel_list_custom_field_options
tools.description: List the options of a LIST custom field, including disabled ones. Weel API: GET /v1/businesses/{client_id}/custom-fields/{custom_field_id}/options.

tools.name: weel_list_custom_field_budgets
tools.description: List the budgets that have this custom field assigned. Weel API: GET /v1/businesses/{client_id}/custom-fields/{custom_field_id}/budgets.

tools.name: weel_list_accounting_codes
tools.description: List the GL (general ledger) accounting codes of the business. Weel API: GET /v1/businesses/{client_id}/accounting-codes.

tools.name: weel_list_categories
tools.description: List expense categories, system and custom. Set custom to true for custom ones only. Weel API: GET /v1/businesses/{client_id}/categories.

tools.name: weel_list_tax_rates
tools.description: List the tax rates configured for the business (read-only). Weel API: GET /v1/businesses/{client_id}/tax-rates.

tools.name: weel_get_tax_rate
tools.description: Get one tax rate by id. Weel API: GET /v1/businesses/{client_id}/tax-rates/{tax_rate_id}.
